labels.TRUE_BREAKOUT: After the D2 signal, all available forward closes in the registered evaluation path remain outside the grid for the required sustained path.
labels.FALSE_BREAKOUT: After the D2 signal, at least one future close returns inside the grid range.
labels.UNRESOLVED: No sufficient future evaluation path exists or neither registered label condition is met.
